old_caption: The video captures an underwater scene featuring a variety of koi fish swimming in a pond. The water is murky, with reflections on the surface. The koi fish display a range of colors, including white, orange, red, and black, with some having distinctive patterns on their bodies. The fish are actively swimming and interacting, with some appearing to hover near the surface. The camera is moving, causing foreground fish to shift in and out of view. The overall scene is active, highlighting the movement of the fish and the dynamic camera perspective.
original_wisa_caption: The video captures an underwater scene featuring a variety of koi fish swimming in a pond. The water is slightly murky, giving it a natural, serene appearance. The koi fish display a range of colors, including white, orange, red, and black, with some having distinctive patterns on their bodies. The fish move gracefully through the water, their fins and tails flowing smoothly as they navigate the space. The camera remains relatively steady, focusing on the movement and interaction of the fish. As the video progresses, the camera angle shifts slightly, providing different perspectives of the fish swimming around. The overall atmosphere is peaceful, highlighting the beauty and tranquility of the underwater world inhabited by these colorful koi fish.
caption: The video captures an under-surface view of a koi pond, where a pale cream-and-white fish fills the left foreground with its tail and rear body angled toward the center, while a red-and-white koi holds a head-up posture at the right edge. Several smaller orange and yellow fish drift through the dark green mid-ground, and bright rippling reflections shimmer across the top. A large, out-of-focus orange fish mass slides in from the upper left, slowly occluding the pale koi's body as it passes. The pale koi rotates and translates, bringing its white, red-spotted head into the upper left with its mouth opening. At the right, the red-and-white koi tilts its head further upward and widens its mouth, holding that open, surface-facing stance. The smaller fish continue shifting horizontally. The framing stays largely steady throughout.
